name: duckling_tuft_crest
rationale: Revision of attempt 0, which failed because the tilted tuft and side bumps did not positively overlap the base or each other. Fix: lower the backward-leaning tuft (center Z=7.0, rotated 20 deg about Y) so its lowest swept Z is about 1 mm, inside the 2.5 mm base thickness, giving solid volume overlap; and lower the bilateral feather bumps (center Z=3.5, radius 3 mm) so each directly overlaps the base (lowest Z about 0.5 mm). Both features therefore connect to the base with positive volume, producing one fused solid. Silhouette stays a soft, friendly duckling tuft in duck-yellow PLA, well under the 35 mm zone height and far from the camera face. Mounting retention, curvature fit and print behavior remain open per the unverified interface.
